messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick ask — we need a short one-pager + a 2-page solution brief targeting enterprise buyers evaluating secure deployment modes (VPC, on-prem, GovCloud). Purpose: webinar follow-up, benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing. Can we draft by EOD Wed?
chris (Sales): 👍 use-case angle: compliance-first buyers want clear SLA bullets + network isolation checklist. Also include a Routing play: which leads go to AE vs AM vs SE.
anil (Eng): happy to give technical blurbs. We should include the runtime guarantees and a short note on fallbacks (hosted -> dedicated -> private).
jamie (Product): I can draft messaging hierarchy: 1) Security & isolation 2) Predictable latency & SLOs 3) Cost controls/Optimize toolkit. Keep the one-pager focused — customers skim.
sofia (Security): Add KMS/HSM + audit-log export + SOC2/ISO certs. Also include short note: "customer-managed keys available". We should avoid promising specifics about encryption-at-rest keys if legal hasn't signed off.
maria (Marketing): Good call. Chris — can you provide the inbound routing thresholds? i.e., MQL -> immediate AE if ARR estimate > X or compliance tag present?
chris (Sales): Routing draft: if ARR estimate >= $250k OR tags contain {govcloud|regulated|enterprise-sla} -> route to AE queue w/ priority flag. If ARR < $250k but compliance=high -> route to AM for discovery. Otherwise standard PLG inbound. Also add checkbox for confidentiality lead (legal).
anil (Eng): SLA + performance snippet for brief: ```SLA: 99.9% availability (monthly), latency SLO: 95th percentile < 150ms for standard models on Dedicated; fallbacks to compatible variants with degraded latency during incidents.```
sofia (Security): Add: "Private deployments support VPC peering, customer-managed routing, and optional air-gapped on-prem packaging." Also note: "KMS integration with AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / customer HSMs."
jamie (Product): Let's include a short benchmark blurb showing typical tail-latency improvements with caching/batching: "Customer example: gen API 60% token-cost reduction with prefix caching, 2.5x throughput using batching on Dedicated." Keep numbers framed as example / anonymized.
maria (Marketing): I'll assemble the drafts into a Google doc and share. Need 1) single-page customer-facing one-pager (sales leave-behind) 2) two-page solution brief (technical + deployment options + routing playbook). Who's volunteer for final review?
chris (Sales): I can review routing and GTM lines.
anil (Eng): I'll review technical + benchmark accuracy.
sofia (Security): I'll double-check security claims and cert lines.
maria (Marketing): Thanks — putting first draft in this link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/1a2b3c-enterprise-brief (please comment inline).
deploy-bot: Document uploaded by maria: enterprise-brief-v1.docx -> https://drive.redwood.com/drive/1a2b3c-enterprise-brief
maria (Marketing): Timeline: please comment by Tue noon PT so we can finalize before webinar next week. Also need a short speaker 30s script for webinar CTA routing.
jamie (Product): Draft speaker CTA: "If your team requires SLAs, private deployments, or managed keys, book a tailored trial and get a compliance review with our solutions engineering team." Short and CTA-forward.
chris (Sales): Add routing CTA line: "When you book a tailored trial, indicate your deployment preference and compliance needs — our AE will triage and schedule a compliance session."
anil (Eng): Quick note for doc: include minimal config snippet for VPC peering doc link: `vpc-peering.redwood.com/docs` and note supported ports: 443 + optional 9090 for metrics.
sofia (Security): Last ask: include a callout: "We can sign BAA and data processing addenda — contact legal@redwood.com for an intake form."
maria (Marketing): Great. I'll incorporate everything and ping when v1 is ready. Thanks all :rocket:
chris (Sales): Thanks, team. I'll prep the routing playbook checklist for the brief.
anil (Eng): Will drop a small graph (latency vs batch size) into the brief, anonymized.
sofia (Security): I'll add cert badges and a short approval note for legal.
maria (Marketing): Closing — milestone: v1 in drive by Tue 11:30am PT, final by Wed EOD. If anyone can't hit that, ping me here. :calendar:
